\*Heat capacity of liquid estimated. Phase changes: 980 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Mn; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.532$ kcal/mol. 1360 K, β - γ transition point of Mn; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.507$ kcal/mol. 1410 K, Y - δ transition point of Mn; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.449$ kcal/mol. 1517 K, melting point of Mn; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.882$ kcal/mol. 1803 K, melting point of MnS; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 6.200$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations:
298.15-1803 K: $Cp^o$ = 11.159 + 2.046x $10^{-3}$ T + 0.152x $10^5$ T $^{-2}$
1803-1900 K: $H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 11.159x $10^{-3}$ T + 1.023x $10^{-6}$ T $^2$ - 0.152x $10^2$ T $^{-1}$ - 3.367
$Cp^o$ = 16.000
$H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 16.000x $10^{-3}$ T - 2.578
Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-980 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -66.605 + 1.349 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.844 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 82.750 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -66.605 - 1.349 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.844 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 41.375 \text{T}^{-1} + 23.773 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
980-1360 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -66.186 - 0.831 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.299 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 4.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -66.186 + 0.831 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.299 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 2.025 \text{T}^{-1} + 9.398 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1360-1410 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -66.158 - 0.603 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.137 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 49.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -66.158 + 0.603 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.137 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 24.675 \text{T}^{-1} + 10.452 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1410-1517 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -65.906 - 1.191 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.072 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 49.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -65.906 + 1.191 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.072 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 24.675 \text{T}^{-1} + 6.094 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1517-1803 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -66.660 - 4.012 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 0.863 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 49.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -66.660 + 4.012 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 0.863 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 24.675 \text{T}^{-1} - 12.653 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1803-1900 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -65.872 + 0.829 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 0.160 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 34.150 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -65.872 - 0.829 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 0.160 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 17.075 \text{T}^{-1} + 21.357 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K based on Adami (1). Entropy at 298 K from Mills (80). Low-temperature heat capacities from Anderson (2). High-temperature data based on Coughlin (25). Heat capacity of liquid estimated.
